description: This file implements a JSON serialization class and functions for secure environment handling, including serialization, deserialization, and file I/O with encryption and integrity checks.

classes.name: JsonSerializable
classes.description: A class that provides JSON serialization and deserialization capabilities, integrating with keymaster serialization and supporting size calculation, serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: JsonSerializable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the JsonSerializable object with a reference to a JSON value.

methods.name: SerializedSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the serialized JSON data including size prefix.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the JSON data into a buffer, including size prefix.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data from a buffer, reconstructing the JSON object.
